name: Villa Faraldi (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villa Faraldi (a tree above a bridge on light blue) within branches, with the inscription Comune di Villa Faraldi in grey above.
history: Municipal flag of Villa Faraldi, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Villa Faraldi arms — tree above a bridge on light blue, crowned, within branches
inscription Comune di Villa Faraldi above the arms
